SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26000851
DOCKET NO. BERL486022/J11145524
PLAINTIFF: FRANKLIN LAKES AFFORDABLE REALTY, LLC
DEFENDANT(S): BRADFORD VANCE AND MARINA VANCE
ATTORNEY:
EHRLICH PETRIELLO GUDIN PLAZA REED PC
60 PARK PLACE
18TH FLOOR
NEWARK, NJ 07102
973-643-0040
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered, I have levied upon and will expose for sale at public vendue on 8th DAY of May 2026 between the hours of twelve and four o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say, at 12:00 P.M. prevailing time at the Large Conference Room, 2 Bergen County Plaza, Hackensack, New Jersey to wit:
All that certain lot, piece or parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon erected, situate, lying and being in FRANKLIN LAKES, County of Bergen and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 5, QUAL. C8105, BLOCK 3403
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
68105 NORTHWOOD DRIVE FRANKLIN LAKES, NJ 07417
The short form description provided herein does not constitute a full legal description. A full legal description is annexed to the Writ of Execution on file with the Sheriff of Bergen County.
Lien(s)/Taxes/CWPP: Upset Price (approx.): $30,000.00 through March 11, 2026. Judgment holder reserves the right to amend the upset price prior to sale to include any additional advances, interest, sheriffs cost and commission to the date of sale. Occupancy Status: Occupied; Nearest Cross Street: Ewing Ave. Dimensions (approx.): 1008 sq. ft.; a condominium unit; Subject to: Amount Due for Taxes: 2nd Quarter taxes due 5/1/2026: $616.00; Amount Due for Sewer Fee: Unknown; Prior Liens: Deed - Restricted Affordable Housing Unit With Restrictions on Resale and Refinancing, dated January 15, 2020, recorded February 13, 2020, in the Bergen County Clerk's Office in Book V 3503 Page 282. Mortgage: To Municipality of Franklin Lakes. Deed-Restricted Affordable Housing Unit With Restrictions on Resale and Refinancing. Principal Amount $314,000 dated January 15, 2020, recorded February 13, 2020, in the Bergen County Clerk's Office in Book V 3503 Page 289. Condominium Arrears: Unknown; PLEASE NOTE THAT WITH CONDOMINIUM UNITS, THERE ARE NO METES AND BOUNDS. SUBJECT TO: ALL UNPAID MUNICIPAL TAXES, ASSESSMENTS, LIENS AND OTHER CHARGES; ANY SET OF FACT WHICH AN ACCURATE SURVEY WOULD DISCLOSE; ANY RESTRICTIONS OR COVENANTS ON RECORD WHICH RUN WITH THE LAND; RIGHTS OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, IF ANY; ANY CONDOMINIUM LIEN PRIOR PURSUANT TO N.J.S.A. 46:88-21, IF ANY; ANY OUTSTANDING PUD OR HOMEOWNER'S ASSOCIATION DUES OR FEES, IF ANY; ANY OCCUPANTS OR PERSONS IN POSSESSION OF THE PROPERTY, IF ANY; ADDITIONALLY MUNICIPAL CHARGES, LIENS, TAXES OR TAX SALE CERTIFICATES AND INSURANCE, IF ANY; AND ANY SUCH TAXES, MUNICIPAL LIENS OR OTHER CHARGES, LIENS, INSURANCE PREMIUMS OR OTHER ADVANCES MADE BY PLAINTIFF PRIOR TO THIS SALE. THE AMOUNT OF UNPAID TAXES MUNICIPAL LIENS AND OTHER CHARGES CAN BE OBTAINED FROM THE LOCAL TAXING AUTHORITY. ALL INTERESTED PARTIES ARE TO CONDUCT AND RELY UPON THEIR OWN INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATION TO ASCERTAIN WHETHER OR NOT ANY OUTSTANDING INTEREST REMAIN OF RECORD AND/OR HAVE PRIORITY OVER THE LIEN BEING FORECLOSED AND, IF SO THE CURRENT AMOUNT DUE THEREON.
Together with all and singular the rights, liberties, privileges, hereditaments and appurtenances thereunto belonging or in anywise appertaining and the reversion and remainders, rents, issues and profits thereof, and also all the estate, right, title, interest, use, property, claim and demand of the said defendants of, in, to and out of the same, be sold to pay and satisfy in the first place unto the said plaintiff plus interest thereon. The property shall be sold subject to all liens and encumbrances of record and the Sheriff makes no representations, express or implied, as to the existence, amount, or validity of any liens and encumbrances on the property which is the subject matter of this sale. This notice is further subject to the Conditions of Sale as set forth by the Sheriff of Bergen County and is subject to the terms and conditions of the Foreclosure Fairness Act. The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice through publication.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $21,213.33 plus interest, costs and fees of the sale, and the Sheriff's fees and commission. Any prior liens, as per the affidavit of consideration, are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
ANTHONY CURETON, SHERIFF
DATED: April 6, 2026
